newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares close range-bound bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: German shares close range-bound bourse higher.

text.p: German shares made modest gains in bourse trade on Friday, but no clear market direction emerged as the market waited the release of key U.S. data due in the early afternoon.
The DAX index of 30 blue chip shares climbed 4.03 points, to close the floor session at 2,684.78, having hovered in a xx-point range throughout.
U.S. September producer prices and retail sales data, due out an hour after the close of floor trade in Germany, will be eyed for clues to the U.S. inflation trend.
"This is one of those 'let's wait for the Americans' kind of days," said a Frankfurt dealer.
Some dealers said the DAX was still in a consolidation phase after a spate of record highs, while others said the index needs a downward correction to around 2,560.

Dealers said that interest was more focused on medium sized stocks than on blue chips. Construction group Philipp Holzmann AG rose 16.50 marks, or almost five percent, to 361.50 marks, after forecasting break even in the current business year.
While Holzmann made gains, rival Hochtief, lost ground, slipping 1.50 marks to 69.00 amid unconfirmed talk that the stock had been downgraded.
Newly founded dialysis group Fresenius Medical care gained more than three percent or 3.40 marks to rise to 116.80 after dealers said the new listing was attracting interest.
